summary: Synchronously list directory entry names while preserving encoding and unspecified OS enumeration order.

semantics.return_value: array of names; strings by default, Buffers when encoding='buffer'
semantics.ordering: unspecified; supplied by underlying directory mechanism

caveats: Do not sort results unless source code does so; Node does not promise directory order.
Recursive mode has distinct result-shape/path semantics and must be preserved.
Directory mutations during enumeration can affect observed entries.

tests.name: lists names without dot entries
tests.expected_behavior: returns entry names excluding . and ..; order is not assumed

tests.name: buffer filename encoding
tests.expected_behavior: entry names are Node-compatible Buffers rather than strings
